Recommender Neural Network

.. py:module:: graph_recc_sys.neural_network

.. py:class:: RecommenderModel(data: ~torch_geometric.data.hetero_data.HeteroData, hyperparams) :module: graph_recc_sys.neural_network

Bases: :py:class:~torch.nn.modules.module.Module, :py:class:~graph_recc_sys.utils.config.DataClass

Neural model for link prediction on a heterogeneous user-item graph.

The model builds initial user and item node representations either from learnable free embeddings or from available node features through embedding/linear transformations. These representations are then propagated through a stack of heterogeneous GraphSAGE convolution layers and finally projected into a latent output space.

In binary mode, the decoder produces a score for each candidate edge using the dot product between user and item embeddings. In triplet mode, the model directly returns normalized node embeddings, which can be used with metric-learning or contrastive objectives.

:param data: Heterogeneous graph containing nodes, node features, and edges. :type data: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:\:py\:class\:\~torch_geometric.data.hetero_data.HeteroData`` :type hyperparams: :param hyperparams: Configuration object containing all model hyperparameters.

Hyperparameters: n_conv_layer (int): Number of heterogeneous convolution layers. n_projs_layer (int): Number of hidden projection layers before the final output layer. dropout_rate (float): Dropout rate applied after convolutions and projection layers. input_channels (int): Dimension of the initial node representations. hidden_channels (int): Dimension of the hidden representations after graph convolutions. out_channels (int): Final latent embedding dimension. mode (str): Output mode of the model. Supported values: "binary" or "triplet". two_tower (bool): If True, uses separate projection heads for users and items. Otherwise, a shared projection head is used. proj_norm (str | None): Normalization type used in projection layers. Supported values: "LayerNorm", "BatchNorm", or None. aggr (str): Aggregation strategy used inside SAGEConv. add_features (bool): If True, initial node representations are built from node features. If False, free embeddings are used for users and items. num_stochastic_item_features (int): Number of additional free embedding components concatenated to item representations when add_features=True. num_stochastic_user_features (int): Number of additional free embedding components concatenated to user representations when add_features=True.

.. attribute:: user_emb

  Free user embedding table used when `add_features=False`.

  :type: Embedding

.. attribute:: item_emb

  Free item embedding table used when `add_features=False`.

  :type: Embedding

.. attribute:: user_embeddings

  Dictionary of modules used to encode user features when
  `add_features=True`.

  :type: ModuleDict

.. attribute:: item_embeddings

  Dictionary of modules used to encode item features when
  `add_features=True`.

  :type: ModuleDict

.. attribute:: user_stochastic_emb

  Optional additional learnable embedding for users.

  :type: Embedding

.. attribute:: item_stochastic_emb

  Optional additional learnable embedding for items.

  :type: Embedding

.. attribute:: convs

  Stack of `HeteroConv` layers based on `SAGEConv`.

  :type: ModuleList

.. attribute:: proj_layer

  Shared projection stack used when `two_tower=False`.

  :type: Sequential

.. attribute:: proj_user_layer

  User-specific projection stack used when `two_tower=True`.

  :type: Sequential

.. attribute:: proj_item_layer

  Item-specific projection stack used when `two_tower=True`.

  :type: Sequential

.. py:method:: RecommenderModel.encoder(data: ~torch_geometric.data.hetero_data.HeteroData) :module: graph_recc_sys.neural_network

  Encode user and item nodes into latent representations.

  :rtype: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`dict\``

.. py:method:: RecommenderModel.decoder(z_dict: dict, edge_label_index) :module: graph_recc_sys.neural_network

  Decode user-item pairs into scalar compatibility scores.

  The score is computed as the dot product between user and item
  latent vectors.

  :param z_dict: Dictionary of node embeddings.
  :type z_dict: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`dict\``
  :type edge_label_index: 
  :param edge_label_index: Tensor containing the user and item indices of candidate edges.

  :returns:     Score for each candidate edge.
  :rtype: torch.Tensor

.. py:method:: RecommenderModel.forward(data: ~torch_geometric.data.hetero_data.HeteroData) :module: graph_recc_sys.neural_network

  Run the full forward pass of the model.

  In `binary` mode, returns edge scores for link prediction.
  In `triplet` mode, returns normalized user/item embeddings.

  :param data: Input heterogeneous graph.
  :type data: :sphinx_autodoc_typehints_type:`\:py\:class\:\`\~torch\_geometric.data.hetero\_data.HeteroData\``

  :returns:     - In `binary` mode: tensor of edge scores
                - In `triplet` mode: dictionary of normalized node embeddings
  :rtype: torch.Tensor | dict
